## Goal

## Context

Easiest installation path for Rust users is cargo install. Need proper metadata first.

**Update:** The crate name `docket` is already taken on crates.io by an unrelated project. Instead of publishing to crates.io, we support:
- `cargo binstall --git https://github.com/steveklabnik/docket docket` (pre-built binaries)
- `cargo install --git https://github.com/steveklabnik/docket` (from source)

## Log

- 2026-01-13: Added repository, keywords, and categories to Cargo.toml
- 2026-01-13: Discovered `docket` name already taken on crates.io
- 2026-01-13: Updated README with installation instructions and warning about crates.io name conflict
- 2026-01-13: Verified pre-built binaries workflow already configured (release.yml + binstall metadata)
